headline: Awarded $1,026,950 contract for Foss 2 and Sabattus Street pump station replacement; approved $450,143 armored rescue vehicle purchase.
summary: The rescue vehicle comes from Lenco Industries, Inc., and the pump station bid went to C.H. Stevenson of Wayne, ME. Every vote was 4-0, including approval of the October 19, 2026 meeting minutes.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the October 19, 2026 meeting, 4-0.
Approved a waiver of competition to buy a Bearcat Armored Rescue Vehicle from Lenco Industries, Inc. for $450,143, 4-0.
Awarded the Foss 2 and Sabattus Street pump station replacement contract to C.H. Stevenson for $1,026,950, 4-0.

plain_text:
FINANCE COMMITTEE 
Lewiston, ME 
Minutes of  
November 9, 2026 
 
PRESENT: Chairman Chittim, Councilor Nagine, Ms. McCabe, and Ms. Hoskins  
 
ABSENT: Mr. Bouh 
 
OTHERS PRESENT: Deputy Director of Budget and Purchasing, Allen Ward, Finance Director, 
Tracy Roy, City Engineer, Jeff Beaule, and Lieutenant, James Theiss 
  
The meeting was called to order at 5:30 p.m.  
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Ms. McCabe, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(154-2026) To approve the minutes of the previous meeting dated October 19, 2026, and to accept 
and place them on file by the Clerk. 
 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
On Motion of Councilor Nagine, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(155-2026) To authorize a waiver of competition for the purchase of a Bearcat Armored Rescue 
Vehicle from Lenco Industries, Inc. for the Police Department at their GSA -quoted price of 
$450,143. 
 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Ms. McCabe, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(156-2026) To award bid 2026-039 for the Foss 2 and Sabattus Street Pump Station Replacement 
project to C.H. Stevenson, Wayne, ME, at their lump sum bid price of $1,026,950. 
 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
VOTED: 
To adjourn at 6:22 p.m.     
 
              ___________________________________ 
                                      Allen Ward 
                                                                    Clerk  
        Finance Committee
